_note: Operating currents from the product spec: 7V output, 15W max (2.15A), served from rectified AC normally and from the 1S LiFePO4 via the TPS61088 boost when AC is shorted. Battery branch sized at min battery voltage 3.0V and 88% boost efficiency: 15W / 0.88 / 3.0V = 5.7A -> 6A. AC/rectifier branch sized at min line 8VAC with the 0.8A charger running. Fuses (F101 4A, F102 10A) are protection, not operating current. Voltages (for the regulator report): BAT 3.2 V is the 1S LiFePO4 cell's nominal (3.0 V minimum); VRECT 10.3 V is the peak at the 8 VAC minimum line, 8 x 1.414 = 11.3 V less two rectifier drops of about 0.5 V. The other rails take their voltage from the regulator that drives them.
